sentences.zh: DACA 的终结是如何被界定为法律问题的，以及奥巴马政府是如何允许这种情况发生的。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, September 6th.
sentences.zh: 今天是9月6日，星期三。

sentences.en: This morning,
sentences.zh: 今天早上，

sentences.en: Secretary Napolitano announced new actions my administration will take to mend our nation's immigration policy.
sentences.zh: 纳波利塔诺部长宣布了我的政府将采取的新行动，以完善我国的移民政策。

sentences.en: Peter Baker, what happens on June 15th, 2012?
sentences.zh: 彼得·贝克，2012年6月15日发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, President Obama showed up in the White House that day to announce that he was taking an executive action.
sentences.zh: 嗯，奥巴马总统那天出现在白宫，宣布他将采取行政行动。

sentences.en: Specifically for certain young people, sometimes called dreamers.
sentences.zh: 专门针对某些年轻人，有时被称为“梦想家”。

sentences.en: That would establish a program for young immigrants who came here illegally and were brought to the country by their parents when they were children, when they were under 16.
sentences.zh: 这将为那些非法来到这里，并在儿童时期（16岁以下）被父母带到这个国家的年轻移民建立一个项目。

sentences.en: There are Americans in their heart, in their minds, in every single way but one, on paper.
sentences.zh: 他们从内心、思想上，在每一个方面都是美国人，除了纸面上。

sentences.en: And for people who qualified, that meant that they were not going to be at risk of
sentences.zh: 对于符合条件的人来说，这意味着他们不会面临

sentences.en: deportation, and they could apply for a work permit that would last for two years that would allow them
sentences.zh: 被驱逐出境的风险，他们可以申请有效期为两年的工作许可，这将允许他们

sentences.en: to come out of the shadows, work legally, and not worry about getting in trouble with employers,

sentences.zh: 也可以像美国公民或美国绿卡持有者那样离开国家再回来。

sentences.en: Let's be clear.
sentences.zh: 我们要明确一点。

sentences.en: This is not amnesty.
sentences.zh: 这不是大赦。

sentences.en: This is not immunity.
sentences.zh: 这不是豁免。

sentences.en: This is not a path to citizenship.
sentences.zh: 这不是通往公民身份的途径。

sentences.en: And it's not even legal status because it was temporary.
sentences.zh: 它甚至不是合法身份，因为它是临时的。

sentences.en: Each two years, you had to get it renewed.
sentences.zh: 每两年，你必须续签一次。

sentences.en: But it was the closest thing to a legal status that any of these folks had ever had.
sentences.zh: 但这是这些人曾经拥有过的最接近合法身份的东西。

sentences.en: And it was a big moment, 800,000 people who were estimated to be affected by this.
sentences.zh: 这是一个重要的时刻，估计有80万人受到影响。

sentences.en: And it brought a lot of them into the light, in effect.
sentences.zh: 实际上，这让很多人重见天日。

sentences.en: We have always drawn strength from being a nation of immigrants, as well as a nation of laws.
sentences.zh: 我们一直从作为一个移民国家以及一个法治国家中汲取力量。

sentences.en: And that's going to continue.
sentences.zh: 这种情况将会继续下去。

sentences.en: And my hope is that Congress recognizes that and gets behind the separate.
sentences.zh: 我希望国会能认识到这一点，并支持这一举措。

sentences.en: All right?
sentences.zh: 好吗？

sentences.en: Thank you very much, everybody.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢大家。

sentences.en: A lot of us on the staff stood in the colonnade to watch him make the announcement.
sentences.zh: 我们很多工作人员站在柱廊下观看他宣布这一消息。

sentences.en: Cecilia Munoz was President Obama's chief domestic policy advisor when he signed DACA.
sentences.zh: 塞西莉亚·穆尼奥斯在奥巴马总统签署 DACA 时担任他的首席国内政策顾问。

sentences.en: A number of us went out there because we knew he was making history and we wanted to be there.
sentences.zh: 我们很多人都去了那里，因为我们知道他正在创造历史，我们想见证这一刻。

sentences.en: It was a lovely sunny day.
sentences.zh: 那是一个阳光明媚的美好日子。

sentences.en: The president was excited to do this.
sentences.zh: 总统很高兴能做这件事。

sentences.en: We were thrilled that he was doing it.
sentences.zh: 我们为他这样做感到激动。

sentences.en: And I have a picture of this day, actually, in my office now that was signed by many of my colleagues.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我现在办公室里还有一张这一天的照片，上面签满了同事的名字。

sentences.en: They gave it to me for my 50th birthday.
sentences.zh: 这是他们在我50岁生日时送给我的。

sentences.en: And we all have a somber look on our faces, and that's because most of us are crying.
sentences.zh: 我们脸上都带着忧郁的表情，那是因为我们大多数人都在哭。

sentences.en: It was a big emotional moment.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常感人的时刻。

sentences.en: This one was a little personal, frankly.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，这件事对我个人来说有点特别。

sentences.en: I'm the daughter of immigrants.
sentences.zh: 我是移民的女儿。

sentences.en: I'm the spouse of an immigrant.
sentences.zh: 我是移民的配偶。

sentences.en: This stuff is personal to me.
sentences.zh: 这些事情对我个人来说意义重大。

sentences.en: Peter, I want to talk about what was going on leading up to that moment in the Rose
sentences.zh: 彼得，我想谈谈在玫瑰园发生的那一刻之前，

sentences.en: Garden that brought President Obama to the decision to do this by executive action.
sentences.zh: 是什么促使奥巴马总统决定通过行政行动来做这件事。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Immigration had challenged and vexed Washington for years by this point.
sentences.zh: 到那时为止，移民问题已经困扰华盛顿多年了。

sentences.en: Well, a major immigration reform bill making its way through the Capitol Hill this week.
sentences.zh: 嗯，本周一项重大的移民改革法案正在国会山推进。

sentences.en: The Senate hoping to approve the legislation before the Fourth of July holiday.
sentences.zh: 参议院希望在7月4日假期前批准该立法。

sentences.en: And Democrats had long supported a comprehensive immigration plan that would allow many illegal immigrants to stay in the country and provide path to either citizenship
sentences.zh: 民主党人长期以来一直支持一项全面的移民计划，该计划将允许许多非法移民留在国内，并为他们提供通往公民身份

sentences.en: or legal status for them.
sentences.zh: 或合法身份的途径。

sentences.en: And a number of Republicans have supported similar legislation.
sentences.zh: 许多共和党人也支持类似的立法。

sentences.en: And that's why I support this reform.
sentences.zh: 这就是我支持这项改革的原因。

sentences.en: Not just because I believe in immigrants, but because I believe in America even more.
sentences.zh: 不仅因为我相信移民，更因为我深爱美国。

sentences.en: But it had never gotten done.
sentences.zh: 但它从未实现。

sentences.en: You know, we constantly became polarized, in particular within the Republican Party.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们不断变得两极分化，特别是在共和党内部。

sentences.en: And so I've called this the always is, always was, and always will be amnesty act.
sentences.zh: 所以我称之为“永远是、过去是、将来也是”大赦法案。

sentences.en: In that, if you is in America illegally, you get amnesty and you get to stay.
sentences.zh: 因为如果你非法在美国，你就能获得大赦并留下来。

sentences.en: If you was in America and were deported, you get to come back.
sentences.zh: 如果你在美国被驱逐出境，你还能回来。

sentences.en: And because of that, Washington had never been able to come up with a consensus view on how to go forward.
sentences.zh: 正因为如此，华盛顿从未能就如何推进达成共识。

sentences.en: It kept bogging down.
sentences.zh: 它一直陷入僵局。

sentences.en: So Congress had never gotten close to doing something that was going to protect these young people from deportation.
sentences.zh: 所以国会从未接近采取任何行动来保护这些年轻人免受驱逐。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the president for three years had urged them to do it.
sentences.zh: 总统三年来一直敦促他们这样做。

sentences.en: And we should stop punishing innocent young people for the actions of their parents by denying them
sentences.zh: 我们应该停止因父母的行为而惩罚无辜的年轻人，剥夺他们

sentences.en: the chance to stay here and earn an education and contribute their talents to build the country where they've grown up.
sentences.zh: 留在这里接受教育并贡献才华，建设他们成长国家的权利。

sentences.en: He spent a lot of time, in particular in 2010, trying to get them to pass what was called the
sentences.zh: 他花了很多时间，特别是在2010年，试图让他们通过当时所谓的

sentences.en: DREAM Act at the time.
sentences.zh: 《梦想法案》。

sentences.en: The DREAM Act would do this.
sentences.zh: 《梦想法案》就是为了做这件事。

sentences.en: And that's why I supported this bill as a state legislator and as a U.S.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我作为州议员和美国参议员支持这项法案，也是我作为总统继续支持它的原因。

sentences.en: senator and why I continue to support it as president.
sentences.zh: 但它失败了。

sentences.en: And that failed.
sentences.zh: 最后，你知道，在2012年，恰逢选举年，他利用自己的行政权力独自采取行动，说，我不会再等

sentences.en: And finally, you know, in 2012, which happened to be an election year, he used his executive authority to take action on his own, saying, I'm not going to wait for
sentences.zh: 国会了。

sentences.en: Congress anymore.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，多年来他一直说他没有权力这样做。

sentences.en: And for years, by the way, he said he didn't have the authority to do that.
sentences.zh: 现在，我知道有些人希望我绕过国会，自己修改法律。

sentences.en: Now, I know some people want me to bypass Congress and change the laws on my own.
sentences.zh: 关于我可以仅仅通过行政命令暂停驱逐出境的说法，事实并非如此。

sentences.en: With respect to the notion that I can just suspend deportations through executive order, that's just not the case.
sentences.zh: 但我们的体制不是那样运作的。

sentences.en: But that's not how that's not how our system works.
sentences.zh: 所以他很清楚这个过程中的法律缺陷。

sentences.en: So he knew well what the legal flaws in this process were.
sentences.zh: 他确实清楚。

sentences.en: He did.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 看，你知道，从批评者的角度来看，法律规定这些人不是合法在这里的，而且美国总统

sentences.en: And look, you know, from the point of view of critics, the law says these people aren't here legally and that the president of the United States doesn't
sentences.zh: 没有权利通过简单地说“是的，他们是非法在这里的，但当涉及到这些人时，我不会执行法律”来规避法律。

sentences.en: have the right to circumvent the law in this view by simply saying, yeah, they're not here illegally, but I'm not going to enforce the law when it comes to these people.
sentences.zh: 现在，批评者中有一位来自阿拉巴马州的参议员，名叫杰夫·塞申斯。

sentences.en: Now, among the critics was a senator from Alabama named Jeff Sessions.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 他是更宽松移民政策的长期批评者。

sentences.en: A longtime critic of looser immigration policies.
sentences.zh: 现在，还有其他共和党人对此抱怨，但并没有真正进行大规模抗议，因为事实上，他们同情该政策的目标。

sentences.en: Now, there were other Republicans who complained about it, but didn't really make a big protest because, in fact, they sympathize with the goals of the policy.
sentences.zh: 但即使是他们，我想他们中很多人也觉得奥巴马总统在法律意义上采取的方式令人不安，

sentences.en: But even they, I think a lot of them found the way President Obama went about it troubling in a legal sense,
sentences.zh: 仅仅因为国会拒绝通过一项法律，并不意味着总统就应该能够通过行政命令来做到这一点。

sentences.en: that just because Congress refuses to pass a law does not mean the president ought to be able to do it by fiat.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们的观点。

sentences.en: That was their view.
sentences.zh: 所以这里有两个问题。

sentences.en: So there are two issues here.
sentences.zh: 一个是政策问题，无论我们是否同意该政策，另一个是合法性问题。

sentences.en: There's the policy, whether we agree with the policy or not, and the legality.
sentences.zh: 而让奥巴马总统在这里受挫的是，虽然很多人确实支持该政策的目标，但其合法性使其非常脆弱。

sentences.en: And what's tripped up President Obama here is that while a lot of people do support the goals of the policy, the legality has left it being very vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 所以，奇怪的是，到了选举年，他的司法部提出了一个新的法律解释，称事实上他确实拥有这种权力，于是他决定使用它。

sentences.en: So, strangely enough, come an election year, his Justice Department came up with a new legal interpretation that said, in fact, he did have that authority and he decided to use it.
sentences.zh: 共和党人在总统的计划宣布之前就对其进行了攻击。

sentences.en: Republicans attacked the president's plant before it was even announced.
sentences.zh: 众议院议长约翰·博纳在总统讲话前几小时发布了他的预先反驳。

sentences.en: House Speaker John Boehner released his pre-bottle hours before the president spoke.
sentences.zh: 总统说，与其共同努力修复我们破碎的移民系统，他却选择独自行动。

sentences.en: Instead of working together to fix our broken immigration system, the president says he's acting on his own.
sentences.zh: 我们的民主制度不是那样运作的。

sentences.en: That's just not how our democracy works.
sentences.zh: 总统之前曾说过他不是国王，也不是皇帝。

sentences.en: The president had said before that he's not king and he's not an emperor.
sentences.zh: 但他表现得确实像一个。

sentences.en: But he's sure acting like one.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，他在可能失去白宫之前就做了这件事。

sentences.en: And it's interesting that he did this right before he conceivably could have lost the White House.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 他希望将其落实到位，以便即使他输了，它也能在他之后继续存在。

sentences.en: He was hoping to put it in place so that it would survive him if he did lose.
sentences.zh: 我认为他的赌注是，如果这个项目到位，罗姆尼总统如果获胜，也不会废除它。

sentences.en: I think his gamble was that if this was in place, President Romney, if he were to have won, wouldn't have undone it.
sentences.zh: 他并不能确定这一点。

sentences.en: He didn't know that for a fact.
sentences.zh: 这是一个赌博。

sentences.en: It was a gamble.
sentences.zh: 但从他的角度来看，这肯定比什么都不做要好。

sentences.en: But it was certainly a better gamble from his point of view than not doing anything.
sentences.zh: 他说得没错。

sentences.en: He's not wrong about that.
sentences.zh: 许多总统倾向于保留前任所做的事情，即使他们并不特别支持这些政策。

sentences.en: Many presidents tend to leave in place the things that their predecessors do, even if they don't particularly support them.
sentences.zh: 我认为罗姆尼总统很可能会保留它，因为这些人是整体非法移民人口中值得同情的一部分。

sentences.en: And President Romney, I think it's a good bet he might have left that in place because, again, these are a sympathetic portion of the overall illegal immigration population.
sentences.zh: 关于这些被父母带入国内的孩子，他们本身没有过错，需要有一个长期的解决方案，让他们知道自己的身份。

sentences.en: And then with regards to these kids who were brought in by their parents through no fault of their own, there needs to be a long-term solution so they know what their status is.
sentences.zh: 塞西莉亚，你和总统对通过行政行动这样做所涉及的法律风险有多了解，以及这会……

sentences.en: Cecilia, how aware were you and the president about the legal risks involved in doing this by executive action and what that would...
sentences.zh: 我们非常清楚法律风险，以及政治风险。

sentences.en: We were very aware of the legal risks and, for that matter, the political risks.
sentences.zh: 奥巴马总统本人在宣布 DACA 的那天说，这比我想要的要少。

sentences.en: President Obama himself, the day he made the DACA announcement, said, this is less than I would like.
sentences.zh: 我没有权力做这里真正需要做的事情，即给予这些年轻人永久身份。

sentences.en: I don't have the authority to do what really needs to happen here, which is to give these young people permanent status.
sentences.zh: 国会必须这样做，但他们失败了。

sentences.en: Congress has to do that, and they have failed.
sentences.zh: 正是因为这是临时的，国会需要采取行动。

sentences.en: Precisely because this is temporary, Congress needs to act.
sentences.zh: 国会今年还有时间通过《梦想法案》，因为这些孩子值得以超过两年的增量来规划他们的生活。

sentences.en: There's still time for Congress to pass the DREAM Act this year because these kids deserve to plan their lives in more than two-year increments.
sentences.zh: 那么在2016年大选后，奥巴马总统把特朗普总统拉到一边说，请保留这个项目。

sentences.en: So after the 2016 election, President Obama pulls President Trump aside and says, please keep this program.
sentences.zh: 这很重要。

sentences.en: This is important.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 我想知道，考虑到那次谈话以及奥巴马总统对此投入了多少心血，你们是否认为 DACA 在某种程度上是安全的。

sentences.en: And I wonder if you all thought, given that conversation and how much investment President Obama had made into this, that DACA was somehow going to be safe.
sentences.zh: 我们从一开始就知道，未来的政府可能会废除 DACA，对吧？

sentences.en: We knew from the very beginning that some future administration could undo DACA, right?
sentences.zh: 这一点始终是真的。

sentences.en: That was always true.
sentences.zh: 即使是国土安全部发布的信息材料，旨在告知人们申请机会时，

sentences.zh: 也明确说明了这是什么以及其中的风险。

sentences.en: made it really clear what this was and what the risks were.
sentences.zh: 作为政府，我们的责任是确保人们获得关于他们所参与事项的准确信息。

sentences.en: That's our responsibility as a government, was to make sure people had accurate information about what they were signing up for.
sentences.zh: 而且，看，没有人指望一个友好的政府会永远存在，尽管显然没有人预料到我们会处于现在的境地。

sentences.en: And, look, nobody expects a friendly administration to be in place forever, although obviously nobody anticipated that we would be where we are now.
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 我今天来这里宣布，奥巴马政府时期实施的 DACA 项目正在被废除。

sentences.en: I'm here today to announce that the program known as DACA that was effectuated under the Obama administration is being rescinded.
sentences.zh: 好的，让我们快进到周二。

sentences.en: Okay, so let's fast forward to Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 现在司法部长杰夫·塞申斯废除了这项行政行动 DACA。

sentences.en: And now Attorney General Jeff Sessions rescinds this executive action DACA.
sentences.zh: 这与宪法规定的权力分立不一致。

sentences.en: It was inconsistent with the Constitution's separation of powers.
sentences.zh: 司法部长塞申斯说他这样做的理由是什么？

sentences.en: What did Attorney General Sessions say were his justifications for doing that?
sentences.zh: （注：原输入共150条，此处补齐第149条）

sentences.en: Well, Attorney General Sessions was very clear.
sentences.zh: 嗯，司法部长塞申斯说得很清楚。

sentences.en: He said this is an unconstitutional program.
sentences.zh: 他说这是一个违宪的项目。

sentences.en: There is no legality for it.
sentences.zh: 它没有合法性。

sentences.en: A president cannot usurp the power of Congress, and the program had to end.
sentences.zh: 总统不能篡夺国会的权力，这个项目必须结束。

sentences.en: The Department of Homeland Security should begin an orderly, lawful wind-down, including the cancellation of the memo that authorized this program.
sentences.zh: 国土安全部应该开始有序、合法的收尾工作，包括撤销授权该项目的备忘录。

sentences.en: Now, of course, it actually is the president's decision to do this,
sentences.zh: 当然，这实际上是总统的决定，

sentences.en: President Trump's decision, but he had the attorney general go out to explain it, which, of course, is very interesting.
sentences.zh: 是特朗普总统的决定，但他让司法部长出面解释，这当然非常有趣。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: President Trump didn't want to be the public face of this policy.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统不想成为这项政策的公众代言人。

sentences.en: Remember, earlier in his presidency, he said that...
sentences.zh: 记住，在他总统任期的早期，他说过……

sentences.en: I want to ask about undocumented immigrants who are here.
sentences.zh: 我想问一下关于在这里的无证移民的问题。

sentences.en: Is there anything you can say to assure them right now that they'll be allowed to stay?
sentences.zh: 你现在能说些什么来让他们放心，让他们知道他们会被允许留下来吗？

sentences.en: They shouldn't be very worried.
sentences.zh: 他们不应该太担心。

sentences.en: They are here illegally.
sentences.zh: 他们是非法在这里的。

sentences.en: They shouldn't be very worried.
sentences.zh: 他们不应该太担心。

sentences.en: I do have a big heart.
sentences.zh: 我确实有一颗宽广的心。

sentences.en: We're going to take care of everybody.
sentences.zh: 我们会照顾好每个人的。

sentences.en: We're going to have a very...
sentences.zh: 我们会有一个非常……

sentences.en: He said he had a great heart for them.
sentences.zh: 他说他对他们怀有宽广的心。

sentences.en: He wanted to treat them with great heart and compassion.
sentences.zh: 他想以宽广的心和同情心对待他们。

sentences.en: So then coming out and being the public face of this turnabout was not something he wanted to do.
sentences.zh: 所以，站出来成为这次政策大转弯的公众代言人，并不是他想做的事。

sentences.en: He left it to Jeff Sessions to do that.
sentences.zh: 他把这件事留给了杰夫·塞申斯去处理。

sentences.en: Why is this White House doing this right now?
sentences.zh: 为什么白宫现在要这样做？

sentences.en: Well, they're kind of up against a wall in terms of this lawsuit threat from the attorney generals of various states.
sentences.zh: 嗯，面对各州总检察长发起的诉讼威胁，他们有点走投无路了。

sentences.en: These attorney generals had set Tuesday, September 5th, as a deadline for a decision to be made.
sentences.zh: 这些总检察长将9月5日星期二定为做出决定的最后期限。

sentences.en: Otherwise, they would be seeking a court order.
sentences.zh: 否则，他们将寻求法院禁令。

sentences.en: And there was every reason to believe that the court might have been sympathetic to those attorney generals.
sentences.zh: 而且有充分的理由相信，法院可能会同情那些总检察长。

sentences.en: Remember, these courts have already turned over part of President Obama's immigration policy when it came to adults.
sentences.zh: 记住，这些法院已经推翻了奥巴马总统关于成年人移民政策的一部分。

sentences.en: So if that was illegal, if that wasn't constitutionally based on his executive authority, then presumably the argument would go, neither is this program.
sentences.zh: 所以如果那是违法的，如果那不是基于他宪法赋予的行政权力，那么推测起来，这个项目也一样。

sentences.en: And what the White House would say is that by making this decision and creating a phase-out type of program that still allowed Congress an opportunity to step in,
sentences.zh: 白宫会说，通过做出这个决定并建立一个分阶段淘汰的项目，仍然让国会有机会介入，

sentences.en: they created a better, more orderly, and more compassionate result than simply letting a court strike it down and having all 800,000 people suddenly be here illegally again.
sentences.zh: 他们创造了一个比仅仅让法院将其推翻，并让所有80万人都突然再次非法滞留这里，更好、更有序、更具同情心的结果。

sentences.en: Now that he has ended this unsustainable and unconstitutional program imposed by the previous administration,
sentences.zh: 既然他已经结束了前任政府强加的这个不可持续且违宪的项目，

sentences.en: the president is calling on the men and women in Congress to fulfill their duty to the American people by truly reforming our immigration system for the good of all people.
sentences.zh: 总统呼吁国会的男男女女们履行他们对美国人民的职责，通过真正改革我们的移民制度来造福所有人。

sentences.en: He's basically throwing it in Congress's lap, saying, you have six months to fix this.
sentences.zh: 他基本上是把问题抛给了国会，说，你们有六个月的时间来解决这个问题。

sentences.en: Otherwise, this politically tough result is going to go into effect, and it'll be your fault, not mine.
sentences.zh: 否则，这个政治上棘手的结果就会生效，那将是你们的错，而不是我的。

sentences.en: In effect, the grenade has been tossed to the other side of Pennsylvania Avenue.
sentences.zh: 实际上，手榴弹已经被扔到了宾夕法尼亚大道的另一边。

sentences.en: We have confidence that Congress is going to step up and do their job.
sentences.zh: 我们相信国会会站出来履行他们的职责。

sentences.en: This is something that needs to be fixed legislatively, and we have confidence that they're going to do that,
sentences.zh: 这是一件需要通过立法来解决的事情，我们相信他们会做到这一点，

sentences.en: and we stand ready and willing to work with them in order to accomplish responsible immigration reform, and that would include DACA is certainly part of that process.
sentences.zh: 我们随时准备并愿意与他们合作，以实现负责任的移民改革，这当然包括将DACA作为该进程的一部分。

sentences.en: There are many Republicans who believe that getting something on the Republican side is not going to be easy,
sentences.zh: 许多共和党人认为，在共和党内部达成共识并不容易，

sentences.en: that the divisions that we see between the center and the right and the Republican Party will become only deeper.
sentences.zh: 我们所看到的共和党中间派和右翼之间的分歧只会变得更深。

sentences.en: What gives you confidence?
sentences.zh: 是什么让你有信心？

sentences.en: With all due respect, I don't think the American people elected Congress to do things that were easy.
sentences.zh: 恕我直言，我认为美国人民选出国会并不是为了让他们做简单的事情。

sentences.en: They elected them to make a government that works, to work properly, and to work for American people, and that's their job.
sentences.zh: 他们选出他们是为了建立一个有效的政府，使其正常运作，并为美国人民服务，这就是他们的工作。

sentences.en: And if they can't do it, then they need to get out of the way and let somebody else who can take on a heavy lift and get things accomplished.
sentences.zh: 如果他们做不到，那么他们就需要让开，让其他能承担重任并把事情办成的人来做。

sentences.en: I mean, in theory, once this goes away and by October of 2019 the program has gone all together,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，理论上，一旦这个项目消失，到2019年10月项目完全终止时，

sentences.en: if Congress doesn't act, all 800,000 would be illegal and therefore, at least in theory, subject to deportation.
sentences.zh: 如果国会不采取行动，所有80万人都会成为非法移民，因此，至少在理论上，会被驱逐出境。

sentences.en: Now, if you currently have one of these work permits and it's going to expire before the next six months, then you have 30 days to ask for it to be renewed, and it can be renewed.
sentences.zh: 现在，如果你目前持有这些工作许可之一，并且它将在未来六个月内到期，那么你有30天的时间申请续期，它是可以续期的。

sentences.en: So you can go up for another two years staying in the country legally under this program.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以根据这个项目再合法留在国内两年。

sentences.en: But anybody whose permit currently expires more than six months from now will just have to live out their permit and then they have to leave.
sentences.zh: 但任何许可证目前在六个月后到期的人，就只能用完他们的许可证，然后他们必须离开。

sentences.en: Or they're probably not going to leave, but they're subject to deportation and they can't have a legal work permit that they've been using for these last several years.
sentences.zh: 或者他们可能不会离开，但他们会被驱逐出境，而且他们不能再拥有过去几年一直在使用的合法工作许可。

sentences.en: Now, these people weren't priorities of deportations in the past for the most part, and most of them didn't actually face that possibility very often.
sentences.zh: 现在，这些人过去大多不是驱逐出境的优先对象，而且他们大多数人实际上并不经常面临那种可能性。

sentences.en: But they knew it was there.
sentences.zh: 但他们知道它存在。

sentences.en: It was always a possibility.
sentences.zh: 它一直是一种可能性。

sentences.en: If they got arrested for something else, they could be potentially deported and they couldn't work in the country illegally.
sentences.zh: 如果他们因为其他事情被捕，他们可能会被驱逐出境，而且他们不能在该国非法工作。

sentences.en: So it's a big change for these 800,000, however it works out.
sentences.zh: 所以无论结果如何，这对这80万人来说都是一个巨大的变化。

sentences.en: So what has it been like for you to watch President Trump rescind DACA?
sentences.zh: 那么，看着特朗普总统废除DACA对你来说是什么样的感受？

sentences.en: For everybody involved in creating DACA, it's been incredibly painful to watch.
sentences.zh: 对于所有参与创建DACA的人来说，看着它被废除是非常痛苦的。

sentences.en: And the thing that I struggle with the most is that I haven't yet to hear anyone articulate a reason that this is a good thing.
sentences.zh: 我最纠结的一点是，我还没有听到任何人说出这是一个好事的理由。

sentences.en: Like, who does this help exactly?
sentences.zh: 比如，这到底帮了谁？

sentences.en: Nobody.
sentences.zh: 谁也没帮。

sentences.en: And nobody's even making the argument that it helps anybody in this country.
sentences.zh: 甚至没有人争辩说这对这个国家的任何人有帮助。

sentences.en: Jeff Sessions is making the argument that it serves the Constitution.
sentences.zh: 杰夫·塞申斯争辩说这是为了维护宪法。

sentences.en: And you yourself have said that you all understood in the Obama administration that this was a legally risky and dubious strategy.
sentences.zh: 而你自己也说过，你们在奥巴马政府时期都明白这是一个法律上冒险且可疑的策略。

sentences.en: Well, we knew we would get sued, but we also knew that deferred action existed and was used in significant ways by Democratic and Republican presidents long before President Obama.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们知道我们会面临诉讼，但我们也知道延期行动在奥巴马总统之前很久就存在，并被民主党和共和党总统以重要方式使用过。

sentences.en: And so we had some real confidence that it would withhold legal scrutiny.
sentences.zh: 所以我们确实有信心它能经受住法律审查。

sentences.en: And the notion that the administration is somehow protecting the Constitution by putting these young people at risk, I just find ridiculous,
sentences.zh: 而且那种认为政府通过让这些年轻人处于危险之中来保护宪法的说法，我简直觉得荒谬，

sentences.en: especially from the administration that just pardoned Sheriff Arpaio, who was convicted of violating people's constitutional rights.
sentences.zh: 尤其是来自刚刚赦免了因侵犯他人宪法权利而被定罪的阿尔派约警长的政府。

sentences.en: It's pretty hard to take seriously the claim that this is about rule of law coming from this administration.
sentences.zh: 来自这个政府的关于这是为了法治的说法，很难让人认真对待。

sentences.en: President Obama has put out a statement on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 奥巴马总统在Facebook上发表了一份声明。

sentences.en: What's his reaction to his successor reversing what he regards as a key element of his legacy?
sentences.zh: 对于他的继任者推翻他视为其政治遗产关键要素的政策，他有什么反应？

sentences.en: He seems, he seemed pained.
sentences.zh: 他看起来，他看起来很痛苦。

sentences.en: Of course he's pained.
sentences.zh: 他当然很痛苦。

sentences.en: You can't know a dreamer and not be pained.
sentences.zh: 你不可能认识一个“追梦人”而不感到痛苦。

sentences.en: These are people he knows, people he cares about, people whose contributions to this country he believes in.
sentences.zh: 这些人是他认识的人，是他关心的人，是他相信他们对这个国家做出贡献的人。

sentences.en: Of course he's pained.
sentences.zh: 他当然很痛苦。

sentences.en: Anybody who is associated with this policy is pained.
sentences.zh: 任何与这项政策有关的人都很痛苦。

sentences.en: I have had former colleagues, when they left the administration, make an effort to reach out to me and say DACA was the favorite thing that we did,
sentences.zh: 我以前的同事在离开政府时，曾努力联系我说，DACA是我们做过的最喜欢的事情，

sentences.en: that they would take pride in for the rest of their lives.
sentences.zh: 他们余生都会为此感到自豪。

sentences.en: I have a hard time expressing my own pain about it because the pain of the dreamers is so much worse.
sentences.zh: 我很难表达我自己的痛苦，因为“追梦人”的痛苦要严重得多。

sentences.en: So going back to where we started, Peter, I wonder how much President Obama's approach to protecting these young undocumented immigrants, kind of not just what he did,
sentences.zh: 所以回到我们开始的地方，彼得，我想知道奥巴马总统保护这些年轻无证移民的方法，不仅仅是他做了什么，

sentences.en: but how he did it.
sentences.zh: 而是他怎么做的，

sentences.en: That ultimately sowed the seeds of this program's demise.
sentences.zh: 最终埋下了这个项目灭亡的种子。

sentences.en: He signed an executive action that worked around Congress.
sentences.zh: 他签署了一项绕过国会的行政命令。

sentences.en: And then we saw the rise of Donald Trump campaigning against precisely that kind of liberal approach to immigration.
sentences.zh: 然后我们看到了唐纳德·特朗普的崛起，他正是针对那种自由派的移民方式进行竞选。

sentences.en: And it turns out that the message resonated.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，这个信息引起了共鸣。

sentences.en: Is there a case to be made that Obama, perhaps unwittingly, helped lay the groundwork for rescinding DACA?
sentences.zh: 有没有可能说奥巴马也许在无意中为废除DACA奠定了基础？

sentences.en: Well, certainly he did.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他当然做到了。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: You reap what you sow.
sentences.zh: 种瓜得瓜，种豆得豆。

sentences.en: If you choose to live by executive power, then you're going to die by executive power because it's easily reversed.
sentences.zh: 如果你选择依靠行政权力生存，那么你就会死于行政权力，因为它很容易被推翻。

sentences.en: The minute one president leaves office, it's up to the next president to decide whether executive actions taken by his predecessors stay on the books or not.
sentences.zh: 一位总统离任的那一刻，就由下一任总统决定他的前任采取的行政行动是否继续有效。

sentences.en: That's why it's better for any president who wants to create lasting change to get Congress to buy in, to get a vote of Congress, to get a bill sent, to get it signed into law.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么任何想要创造持久变革的总统最好让国会买账，获得国会投票，通过法案，并将其签署为法律。

sentences.en: Much, much, much harder to undo.
sentences.zh: 那样要撤销就难得多、多、多了。

sentences.en: And President Obama's inability, failure, whether it's his fault or not,
sentences.zh: 而奥巴马总统在头两年无法在国会通过这项法案，无论是不是他的错，

sentences.en: in his first two years to get this through Congress meant that he turned to a form of governing that was always going to be vulnerable to the next president's decisions.
sentences.zh: 意味着他转向了一种注定会受到下一任总统决定影响的治理形式。

sentences.en: Look, executive action is ephemeral.
sentences.zh: 看，行政行动是短暂的。

sentences.en: I mean it's just not lasting and that's why it's very attractive to every president to sit there and say, hey, with the sweep of a pen, I can change policy.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是它并不持久，这就是为什么每一位总统都觉得坐在那里说，嘿，只要挥一挥笔，我就能改变政策，这非常有吸引力。

sentences.en: I can make the country different.
sentences.zh: 我可以让国家变得不同。

sentences.en: But it doesn't laSt.
sentences.zh: 但它并不持久。

sentences.en: It doesn't necessarily laSt.
sentences.zh: 它不一定持久。

sentences.en: And that's the vulnerability, the weakness, the fragility of that approach to governing.
sentences.zh: 这就是那种治理方法的脆弱性、弱点和不稳定性。

sentences.en: He would say – President Obama would say he had no choice.
sentences.zh: 他会说——奥巴马总统会说他别无选择。

sentences.en: Republicans were obstructionists.
sentences.zh: 共和党人是阻挠者。

sentences.en: They refused to go along with him on Capitol Hill.
sentences.zh: 他们在国会山上拒绝配合他。

sentences.en: He had to do this because it was the only way to make progress.
sentences.zh: 他必须这样做，因为这是取得进展的唯一途径。

sentences.en: But we do see today from his point of view and the point of view of his supporters, there's obviously a weakness to that.
sentences.zh: 但我们今天从他的角度和他的支持者的角度来看，这显然有一个弱点。

sentences.en: Peter, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 彼得，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Oh, thank you.
sentences.zh: 哦，谢谢你。

sentences.en: It's always good to talk to you, Mike.
sentences.zh: 和你交谈总是很高兴，迈克。

sentences.en: Okay, bye.
sentences.zh: 好的，再见。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重塑者》，这是一个关于设计之爱及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you.
sentences.zh: 即使在我还在黑胶唱片时代在夜总会做DJ的时候，每天晚上你都要带着300件你最珍贵的财产去上班。

sentences.en: And you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你会把DJ台变成一个活生生的、充满50年历史精美文物的快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼的《重塑者》。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费试用《时报》一个月，而无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用程序中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间越过付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他事情。

sentences.en: Just days after Hurricane Harvey devastated parts of Texas and Louisiana, another storm, Hurricane Irma, is strengthening over the Atlantic Ocean,
sentences.zh: 在飓风“哈维”摧毁德克萨斯州和路易斯安那州部分地区仅几天后，另一场风暴，飓风“艾尔玛”，正在大西洋上空加强，

sentences.en: threatening to hit the Caribbean as early as Tuesday night and possibly southern Florida by the end of the week.
sentences.zh: 威胁最早在周二晚上袭击加勒比地区，并可能在周末前袭击佛罗里达州南部。

sentences.en: The National Weather Service is calling Irma an extremely dangerous and potentially catastrophic Category 5 storm.
sentences.zh: 国家气象局称“艾尔玛”为极其危险且可能造成灾难性的5级风暴。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周在《Wirecutter秀》上，我们正在为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让你的客人感到宾至如归的建议。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they black out to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为那是一件非常具体的事情。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on The New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何地方找到《Wirecutter秀》。
